target.description: Id of exactly one {node} (`<{group}>/<{node}>`); {group} ids are rejected

log.description: trace: trace.log (StartCLI trace download); webservice: webservice.log (unsupported, needs unsupported.serverLogRead)

targetFolder.description: Absolute path of a local folder for the log file; created owner-only if missing; same folder rules as export_archives

tailLines.description: Number of newest lines (or newest matching lines with contains) in the excerpt

contains.description: Plain text (not a pattern), matched case-insensitively against the masked lines

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of the excerpt lines; older lines are dropped first
